costumes.name: Extreme Fighter
costumes.description:
Milk costume.
Obtained from the Costume Shop.

lines.text: Hey Punk, what's your problem? Come here and say it to my face!
Hey, are you any good at fighting?
I'll take you all on! That oughta scare 'em, don't you think?

Do you want some milk coffee?
I brought it myself just for you!
I want to know everything about you, no matter how trivial it is.
What? Why are you poking me all the time? Are you challenging me to a duel?
Why call me here for nothing? I'm a busy woman!

I can practice punching here, so don't mind me.
But considering how long you kept me waiting, I'd say you owe me dinner!
Milk Coffee is our best seller at the coffee shop!
Looks like we've got a couple unwelcome customers. Allow me to show them the door.
When I'm here, I can be myself. I don't have to worry about what expectations other people have of me.
Leave the fighting to me, I'll show them what for!
Powering up!
All right, who wants some of this?!
I'm ready to rock!
Hmm? Is this a gift? Wow!
Thanks, Pal. I'll be sure not to waste it.
What are you giving me a gift for? Well, thanks anyway.
If anyone is giving you a hard time, just let me know and I'll set them straight.
I'm curious about what your real personality is.
If you're the one drinking it, then the milk coffee is on me.
All right, let's do this!
What do you want me to do?
Setting out!
You're not going anywhere, you twerps!
No... you're dead meat!
Time to turn it up to 11!
C'mon, give me all you've got!
Hmph, you just wait and see.
Come on, come on, come on!
I'm in the zone!
Right now!
Try this one on for size!
Go back to hell where you belong!
Nice!
Hah hah!
I almost feel sorry for you... but not quite!
Ow!
Damn it.
Ugh!
I didn't lose! This is a tactical withdrawal.
Another victory for us, thanks to me!

favorite.name: Lover Mug
favorite.description: I wish to share a cup of coffee with you every evening, reflecting on the day gone by, and every morning, welcoming a brand new day together. The mug may be simple in design, but its sentiment is far from ordinary.
